Astra Interview Experience | On-Campus for SDE-Intern
★Most Important:
Stipend Offered (Part-time): 20K/Month
CTC (After PPO): 16L + ESOPs
Saurabh Suresh Powar
TY Electronics
In the second half of January, Astra visited the VJTI campus for the Software Development Internship. There was one screening round, one development assignment, and two interview rounds in the hiring process.
Round 1 (Resume Screening Round):
It was open for all branches, also there were no pointer(CGPA) criteria for applying. All students were asked to fill out the application form and submit their resumes. Around 60 resumes were shortlisted in this screening round.
Round 2 (Development Assignment):
As part of this round, we were requested to complete one assignment. We had a choice to choose from Frontend or Backend. Being an AI/ML guy, I decided to go for Frontend as my development skills were not that great.
Problem Statement:
Create a webpage as shown in the attached designs using React.
1. The design must be responsive (Please refer to web and mobile view in the designs)
2. The likes and feedback to be stored locally in the session.
3. The images should be fetched from any free avatar APIs.
Designs:
https://www.figma.com/file/FAi7QsMN0p1vimvRqTEtBa/Assignment?node-id=0%3A1
The deadline for this task was around 48 Hours. We were also asked to deploy it somewhere and share the link to it along with the code.
If you have a decent knowledge of ReactJS, this assignment can be considered as Easy-Medium level.
Round 3 (Technical Interview):
The interview was conducted on Google Meet for 45 minutes duration.
Following were the questions asked to me.
1. Introduce yourself.
I was preparing this question for around the last 5 months, so I nailed it, my initial impression was very good, which plays a very crucial role in the interviews. :)
2. Then they asked me if I had a good understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms as I was from the Electronics branch.
After getting an affirmative response from me, they asked me to code & explain this question:
●Find the first non-recurring character in a String
I started explaining the Brute Force solution but they didn’t want a Brute/Brute-better solution, they were expecting the most Optimal solution. I got a little nervous at first, the interviewer asked me to calm down & take my time. After thinking for a while, I was able to give the most optimal solution and they were satisfied with it.
The second question was:
●Majority Element(N/2) - Leetcode
I had practiced this question before, So I was able to code the most optimal solution for this as well.
3. Then, they asked me some common DBMS & SQL questions. They were very basic I was able to answer all of them.
4. Next, they asked me to explain the code & workflow of the assignment they had given in the previous round. I explained it very well, they were pretty satisfied with my work.
5. Then he asked me how many days it would take me to learn a new Techstack if I was given work on it.
Round 3 (HR Interview):
In this round, the interviewers asked me many behavioral questions, this round went for around 15 minutes.
We started off by introducing ourselves.
1. They asked some questions about my previous Internships.
2. What will you prefer, CTO at Astra or SDE at Google?
3. What are your Future Plans?
4. What is your Chess rating, other hobbies?
5. 50L CTC at Astra or MS and Job in Abroad?
6. Family Background.
7. Why Astra, SDE?
8. Any questions for us:
At around 8 PM, I received a mail that I was shortlisted for Astra. 4 students were shortlisted for Internship :)
Tips/Resources:
●DSA: Striver SDE Sheet, Must do coding questions on GFG, Leetcode
●DBMS: OP playlist by Knowledge Gate
●SQL: Gate Smashers
●OS: Knowledge Gate
